The rental quotation covers the palletizer, installation support, and operator training, and Bay 7 has adequate access for delivery. I have the authority to approve this rental and set deployment conditions, but before I do, I'd like to follow our normal pre-deployment review process. Could maintenance, safety, quality, and production training each report any relevant requirements they have for this equipment? That way we can make sure we're covering all our bases before I give the final approval.
